title: Consolidation of DAO Forum opinions using GPT
tagline: Chrome extension that uses GPT to concisely summarize the large volume and complexity of discussions in DAO's forums.
description: There's a lot of discussion going on at DAO every day. On the other hand, one of the reasons for the wide variety and depth of the topics of debate is the low turnout. Professional delegates are also struggling. Therefore, we will create a tool to easily summarize the discussions in the forum by utilizing GPT, an LLM developed by OpenAI.
how_its_made:
First, create a Chrome extension that retrieves the source code of the page you are viewing. Extract only the content text from the source code.

Next, create a prompt for GPT, an LLM developed by OpenAI. This text should be summarized in terms of summary, pro and con opinions.

Connect to GPT's API and display the results in the extension's POPUP.

Although we were able to implement the individual functions, the integration did not work and we were ultimately unable to display the results in POPUP.
